{{Nihongo|'''Agata no Inukai clan'''|県犬養氏}} was a {{ill|Shinabe clans|en|Shinabe clans|qid=Q11418456|lt=Shinabe clan}} tasked with guarding the {{ill|kyūmon|Miyamon|Miyamon|ja|宮門|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135500726}} and the directly administered estates such as {{ill|Miyake|Tonsō|Tonsō|ja|屯倉|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11465761}} of the {{ill|Yamato Kingship|Yamato Court|Yamato Court|ja|大和朝廷|ja_comment=|2=ja|3=ヤマト王権|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q2658252}}. The Agata Inukai Clan, together with '''{{ill|Waka Inukai Clan|Waka Inukai Clan|Waka Inukai Clan|ja|若犬養氏|lt=Waka Inukai|lt_ja=稚犬養|lt_de=Junger Inukai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q55533707}}''', '''{{ill|Adon Inukai Clan|Adon Inukai Clan|Adon Inukai Clan|ja|阿曇犬養氏|lt=Adon Inukai|lt_ja=阿曇犬養|lt_de=Adon Inukai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65291952}}''', '''{{ill|Kai Inukai Clan|Kai Inukai Clan|Kai Inukai Clan|ja|海犬養氏|lt=Kai Inukai}}''', '''{{ill|Kara Inukai Ren|Kara Inukai Ren|Kara Inukai Ren|ja|辛犬養連}}''', and '''{{ill|Ata-no-Mite-Inukai|Adamo-te Inukai|Adamo-te Inukai|ja|阿多御手犬養|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135500730}}''' formed one of the six clans led by {{ill|Tomonomiyatsuko|Banzō|Banzō|ja|伴造|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11381545}}. The term "Agata" is believed to denote lands directly controlled by the court, though this remains uncertain<ref>World Encyclopedia, 2nd edition, 'Ken Inukai Clan'</ref>.
== Overview ==
{{ill|Kamimusubi|en|Kamimusubi|qid=Q3275901|qid=Q3275901|lt=Kamimusubi's}} descendants, a {{ill|Clan|en|Clan|qid=Q211503|lt=Clan}} of the {{ill|Shinbetsu|Shinbetsu|Shinbetsu|ja|神別}}, originally bore the surname {{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|qid=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}. However, during the Jinshin War in {{ill|672|en|672|qid=Q30601|lt=672 AD}} ({{ill|Hakuhō|Hakuhō|Hakuhō|ja|白鳳|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11580612}} first year), the majority of the clan distinguished themselves as {{ill|Retainer|Retainer|Retainer|ja|舎人|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q126081127}} to {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|en|Emperor Tenmu|qid=Q335181|lt=Prince Ōama (future Emperor Tenmu)}}. In {{ill|684|en|684|qid=Q31128|lt=684 AD}} ({{ill|Hakuhō|Hakuhō|Hakuhō|ja|白鳳|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11580612}} 13th year), with the establishment of the {{ill|Eight Kabane system|Eight-Colored Surname|Eight-Colored Surname|ja|八色の姓|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391729}}, they were granted the {{ill|Sukune|en|Sukune|qid=Q11455653|lt=Sukune}} surname.
In the {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}, in the article on Sakyō Divine Agata Inukai Sukune, their genealogy is recorded as "the eighth-generation descendant of {{ill|Kamimusubi|en|Kamimusubi|qid=Q3275901|qid=Q3275901|lt=Kamimusubi}} and a descendant of Akitato no Mikoto," while in the account by Ōkurai Shiren they are described as "of the same ancestral origin as Agata Inukai."
The clan's {{ill|Agata no Inukai no Michiyo|en|Agata no Inukai no Michiyo|qid=Q11582685|lt=Agata no Inukai no Michiyo}} served in the courts of five successive reigns—those of {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|en|Emperor Tenmu|qid=Q335181|lt=Tenmu}}, {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Jitō}}, {{ill|Emperor Monmu|en|Emperor Monmu|qid=Q357246|lt=Monmu}}, {{ill|Empress Genmei|en|Empress Genmei|qid=Q233224|lt=Genmei}}, and {{ill|Empress Genshō|en|Empress Genshō|qid=Q235343|lt=Genshō}}—and received the {{ill|Tachibana clan (kuge)|en|Tachibana clan (kuge)|qid=Q1500519|lt=Tachibana clan}} from Emperor Genmei. She, while assisting her husband {{ill|Fujiwara no Fuhito|en|Fujiwara no Fuhito|qid=Q177517|lt=Fujiwara no Fuhito}}, also promoted her clan's prosperity by making {{ill|Agatainukai no Hirotoji|Ken Inukai Hirotōji|Ken Inukai Hirotōji|ja|県犬養広刀自|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11582687}} the consort of {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|en|Emperor Shōmu|qid=Q349263|lt=Emperor Shōmu}}. During the era of her son {{ill|Tachibana no Moroe|en|Tachibana no Moroe|qid=Q3135863|lt=Tachibana no Moroe}}, only one clan member, {{ill|Agata Inukai no Ishiji|Ken Inukai Ishitsugi|Ken Inukai Ishitsugi|ja|県犬養石次|lt=Ishitsugi|lt_ja=石次|lt_de=Ishitsugi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17988277}}, served as a {{ill|Sangi (Japan)|en|Sangi (Japan)|qid=Q1133663|lt=Sangi}}; however, after Morokage lost power, the Agata Inukai Clan eventually declined.
